coverage.note: Classification is code-generation planning metadata. It is not evidence that a binding adapter was generated, compiled, linked, executed, or conformance-tested.

callback.blocker: callback lifetime, thread affinity, reentrancy, and finalization need policy
callback.description: Accepts or returns a function pointer/callback alias.

constructor.blocker: storage layout, allocation arena, ownership, and failure policy need implementation

destructor.blocker: ownership provenance and exactly-once finalization need implementation

enum-handle.blocker: enum width, handle ownership, and nullability need ABI policy
enum-handle.description: Uses an enum, named integer, or opaque handle representation.

method.blocker: receiver type, lifetime, constness, and dynamic type need verification
method.description: Requires an implicit native C++ this object.

out-param.blocker: output initialization, ownership transfer, and failure semantics need policy
out-param.description: Contains a pointer-to-pointer, mutable reference, or explicitly named output pointer.

platform-gated.blocker: availability and symbol linkage must be verified for every target platform
platform-gated.description: Names a platform- or graphics-backend-specific native API.

pointer.blocker: pointee lifetime, mutability, alignment, and nullability need policy
pointer.description: Uses a native pointer without a detected length companion.

pointer-span.blocker: element unit, bounds, direction, and copy-vs-borrow policy need verification
pointer-span.description: A pointer is paired with an explicit size, count, or capacity.

record-reference.adapter: layout-verified record view or value thunk
record-reference.blocker: record size, alignment, field layout, and reference lifetime need verification
record-reference.description: Passes or returns a C++ record/reference value.

scalar-direct.blocker: native symbol adapter is not generated or linked
scalar-direct.description: Only ABI scalar values are passed or returned.

template-opaque.blocker: the finite supported specialization set must be selected and instantiated
template-opaque.description: Depends on a template declaration, specialization, or template parameter.

variadic.adapter: typed non-variadic facade per supported call shape
variadic.blocker: a generic TypeScript-to-native varargs ABI is not safe or portable
